Lessons: (1) every verificationIntent's desc embeds a literal CLI command — bind evidence.command verbatim; (2) for over-reach guards use three-dot diff (git diff main...HEAD) not two-dot, because parallel stories merging to main between worktree create and DONE inject false positives (here B-40eb landed mid-story with 2167 lines of verify-*.mjs and 4621 lines of *-smoke.ts changes); (3) scope_contract_acknowledge requires --paths as JSON array, not repeated --path. Next person: write the binding helper as a strict mapper from intent.desc to command, and add a smoke check that fails if any two evidences share the same command string.
